summary: Testing of TrendySubscriptionCards dynamic pricing fix. Verified that subscription cards now fetch prices from GET /api/subscription-plans API. Premium shows $180/year (original $360, 50% OFF), VIP shows $300/year (original $600, 50% OFF). All prices are dynamically loaded - no hardcoded $99.99/$299.99 values remain.
critical_code_review_comments: TrendySubscriptionCards.js correctly fetches from GET /api/subscription-plans on mount
getPlanPrice() returns plan.price_yearly from API response, not hardcoded value
getOriginalPrice() returns plan.original_price_yearly for strikethrough display
PersonalizedSavingsCalculator.js also fetches dynamic prices for ROI calculation
SubscriptionManager.js admin component fetches dynamic prices for revenue calculation
seed_data_creation: None - used existing subscription plans data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic pricing fully working in TrendySubscriptionCards. Current DB values: Premium yearly=$180 (original=$360), VIP yearly=$300 (original=$600). The old hardcoded $99.99 Premium and $299.99 VIP prices are no longer displayed.
